messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: INCIDENT fired for service az-east-3-nic-loss (Severity: P1). Link: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/P12345 - automated detection: NIC packet loss > 20% across az-east-3 fabric.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P12345 assigned to oncall-ryan (SRE). Notification sent.

oncall-ryan: Acked. I'm looking. Any immediate customer noise?

sre-maya: seeing elevated 5xxs for hosted inference in az-east-3, TTL spike on routing. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/az-east-3/network - partial egress loss.

network-eng-lee: Confirmed micro-bursts on TORs in az-east-3-A and az-east-3-B. BGP sessions flapping to the fabric switches. Snippet from netflow:```
00:12:34.567 IN: drop_pct=24.3
00:12:35.000 IFACE=eth0 errors=120
00:12:36.123 BGP_STATE=Active->Idle
```

eng-runtime-eli: Impact on model serving: KV-cache misses up ~40% for sessions routed to az-east-3. Might exceed our latency SLO for streaming endpoints. Recommend temporary routing fallback to az-east-1/az-east-2 and promote a lower-memory model variant for those AZs to absorb load.

infra-sam: Can we flip routing policy now? We have a tested fallback policy: `route-policy az-fallback-2026`. If agree, I'll push. Need oncall approval to run change.

oncall-ryan: Do it. Prioritize customer traffic. Sam, run canary first to 10% then 100 if stable.

ops-bot: Running change: `rbac run route-policy apply az-fallback-2026 --canary 10% --target az-east-1,az-east-2`

ops-bot: Command output:
```
[INFO] canary started to 10% of traffic - groups: inference,chat,embeddings
[INFO] monitoring health metrics for 3m window
```

sre-maya: Observing immediate drop in 5xxs from 12.8% -> 3.1% on canary traffic. No new errors in az-east-1/2 so far. Latency stable.

customer-success-ana: I'll draft a short status note for affected customers (sent to CS slack draft channel). Proposed: "We are experiencing partial networking disruption in one AZ; we have rerouted traffic to healthy zones and are monitoring. No action required from customers." Want this on the status page once we confirm canary stable. :thumbsup:

eng-lead-zoe: We should also enable the quantized variant q4_optimized for the heavier routes in az-east-1/2 to reduce memory pressure. eng-runtime-eli, can you coordinate automatic model pinning?

eng-runtime-eli: On it. Pushing rollout: `modelctl pin --model-id rdlv2-q4 --target az-east-1,az-east-2 --rollout canary=20%`

ops-bot: `modelctl` output:
```
[OK] pinned rdlv2-q4 to az-east-1,az-east-2 (canary 20%)
[OK] autoscaler adjusted reservations
```

network-eng-lee: TOR flaps reduced after leaf software restart we triggered manually (leaf-22). Still seeing some retransmits but routing fallbacks are holding.

oncall-ryan: Good. Sam, continue full rollout to 100% for routing fallback when metrics look good for 5 minutes. Notify PD if any regressions.

ops-bot: Canary window complete: 5m. Health checks:
- 5xx rate: canary 3.1% -> 1.2%
- p99 latency: unchanged
- model errors: none
Rolling to 100% now.

ops-bot: Full rollout complete. Traffic now routed: az-east-3 (~0%), az-east-1 (52%), az-east-2 (48%).

customer-success-ana: Status page update staged: https://status.redwood/infrastructure - posting now. Message: "Mitigated: Traffic rerouted from az-east-3 due to network disruption; services operating from healthy zones. Engineers are investigating root cause; incident remains open."

pagerduty-bot: Acknowledgement: P12345 has been acknowledged and status updated to Mitigated. Next action: postmortem owner assignment.

infra-sam: Assigning postmortem to network-eng-lee and infra-sam. ETA initial RCA in 4 hours.

eng-lead-zoe: Add a follow-up action to evaluate fallback automation to trigger earlier (under 2 minutes) and test failover in DR exercises.

oncall-ryan: Handoff: I'll run a 30-min watch and then hand to oncall SRE night shift. Leaving runbook notes here:
```
- routing fallback applied: az-fallback-2026
- model pin: rdlv2-q4 pinned to az-east-1/2
- commands run: rbac run route-policy apply..., modelctl pin...
- monitoring dashboards: grafana/inference, grafana/network
```

eng-runtime-eli: Quick note: we saw increased KV miss rate during the initial reroute; we enabled prefix caching on az-east-1 which dropped miss rate by ~28%. Command used: `cachectl enable-prefix --zone az-east-1 --ttl 600s`

ops-bot: cachectl output:
```
[OK] prefix cache enabled az-east-1 ttl=600s
[OK] warmed 1.2M prefixes
```

network-eng-lee: Subnet vendor confirmed firmware bug causing buffer exhaustion on specific NICs. Vendor tracking patch; prep scheduled for 03:30 UTC.

oncall-ryan: Thanks all. Incident status: Mitigated (fallback active). Postmortem assigned. I'm signing off the immediate page - handing to infra-sam for follow-up.

incident-bot: Incident P12345 updated: status=Mitigated, severity=P1->P2, owner=network-eng-lee, follow_up="postmortem by infra-sam & network-eng-lee - initial RCA in 4h".

eng-lead-zoe: Good job team. We'll loop in customer success for any customers with SLA impact.

customer-success-ana: Noted. Preparing targeted outreach for top 5 customers and legal/compliance if needed.

oncall-ryan: Closing my live hand-off. If anything degrades, re-open PD.

incident-bot: Thread closed for active paging. Further updates will be added to the postmortem document. Thank you. :white_check_mark:
